name: Angelique Trois
original_name: アンジェリーク トロワ
source:
Set three years after Tenkuu no Requiem. 

Collet and Rachel who become the Queen and Queen's aide of the Sacred Beast Cosmos and their allies from the Sacred Bird Cosmos were trapped in a foreign continent whom Limoges, the Queen of Sacred Bird Cosmos named "Arcadia" and they stand before a mysterious silver tree. 

Collet hears a voice pleading to "release the seal", soon discovering the continent is on the verge of collapse within its pocket dimension. Limoges uses her powers to create a barrier to stall the destruction to occur in 115 days. With the help of her allies, Collet has to save and developed Arcadia within the time.
